exposure: psychosocial factors (social support and social media usage)
cohort: 220 mothers under 6 months postpartum registered in public health centers in Kungyangone Township, Yangon, Myanmar
finding: Unplanned pregnancy, less than four antenatal care visits, travel time more than 1 hour to reach health centers, and birth interval more than 5 years were associated with increased odds of postpartum depression, while preterm delivery was inversely associated.
